scripts.setup: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:frontend: nodemon --watch frontend/src --watch frontend/public --ext js,jsx,ts,tsx,css,scss,html,json,svg --exec "npm run build"
